dspace-header.title: Civics Research Repository Metadata Registry
dspace-header.contributor.author: Civics Research Repository
dspace-header.description: Project-specific metadata fields used to track public source identity, geography, vintage, and documentation links.

dc-type.scope_note: Stable source identifier assigned by Civics Research Repository sync adapters.
Normalized geographic level represented by the source dataset.
Source dataset vintage or release year.
Authoritative source URL for the public dataset or file manifest.

One JSON entry per source file: id, bundle, format, url, and size where known. Public datasets are represented by manifests and links rather than mirrored bitstreams, so this field is where the file list lives.
Research object type: DATASET, PUBLICATION, CODE, METHODOLOGY, SUPPORTING_MATERIAL, or PROJECT. Absent means DATASET, which is what every item seeded before research packages existed is.
One JSON entry per typed relationship: verb and target source identifier. Verbs are directional and asserted only where they are true of the objects themselves, never inferred from shared geography.
Access level: PUBLIC, RESTRICTED, METADATA_ONLY, or EMBARGOED. A restricted object still carries citation, provenance, and instructions for legitimate access; it carries no files.
Reuse terms for the object, stated rather than assumed.
How a researcher legitimately obtains a restricted object. Present only where access is not PUBLIC.
Persistent scholarly identifier, where one exists. Omitted rather than invented when it does not.
One JSON entry per author: name, and ORCID where the researcher has a public one. The ORCID key is absent rather than blank when unknown.
